I was messing around with another card that had multiple characters, and a very bare-bones version of something like this came up as a side character. I was intrigued, and went about trying to make it.

This kind of thing isn't what I'm into, but I see the appeal. This is my first character ever, so be kind, but do let me know how I can improve this or future characters. I'm learning. If this is well received I might post more, so PLEASE let me know any feedback you might have. 

But seriously... don't fuck with her. It will not end well for you. I tried once, and she did not hesitate to drop me like a sack of potatoes. Which, as it turns out was the intended behavior. :)
